The continuous red-bean ribbon is the characteristic detail.

g.id: Rice and bean bowl / cutout sticker

path.id: Rolling creates a continuous spiral of red-bean filling between layers of dough. Its progressively expanding turns reveal how the food is made. This is a spiral structure, rather than a radial pattern or a fully symmetrical arrangement, and it can be reduced to one continuous line.
The short cylindrical roll is a common food shape. Its outer silhouette alone does not communicate the distinctive winding of the filling inside.
The powder coating and irregular surface texture describe the finish, but they are small surface details. They do not explain how the dough and filling are rolled together.
A literal image suggested by the name would shift attention away from the food itself. The visible rolled structure offers a more direct basis for this icon.
